_comment: DB tier (RDS) - tightest of the three. Ingress only from the app tier's SG on the DB port, nothing else. Egress is deliberately NOT left at the default all-outbound: a database has no legitimate reason to initiate outbound connections, so this locks egress down to nothing at all. Apply this file with apply-rules.sh's --prune flag on a freshly created group so the default all-outbound egress rule gets removed, not just left alongside these.
